summary: IdentityLookup is app extensions for SMS/MMS filtering, spam reporting and Live Caller ID Lookup, all tied to the cellular phone and Apple's call directory. BifrOSt has no telephony, SMS or call-blocking stack, so there is no counterpart.

features.apple: Message Filter app extension (SMS and MMS Message Filtering)
features.note: no SMS or MMS stack on BifrOSt PC

features.apple: Unwanted Communication app extension (SMS and Call Spam Reporting)
features.note: no phone calls or SMS to report
requires the system call directory; no telephony on the PC

features.feature: Call blocking and identity data payloads (PIR)
features.apple: Formatting data for blocking and identity information; HTTP endpoints for Live Caller ID Lookup
features.note: server-side protocol tied to the Apple call directory
